mapper.sql: t.tenant_code AS tenant_code, e.company_name AS company_name, e.industry AS industry, t.plan_id AS plan_id, t.status AS tenant_status, t.isolation_mode AS isolation_mode, t.expire_time AS expire_time, t.create_time AS create_time, COALESCE(q.daily_request_limit, 0) AS daily_request_limit, COALESCE(q.ai_daily_limit, 0) AS ai_daily_limit, COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count) FILTER (WHERE u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 29), 0) AS requests_30d, COALESCE(SUM(u.session_count) FILTER (WHERE u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 29), 0) AS sessions_30d, COALESCE(SUM(u.ai_call_count) FILTER (WHERE u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 29), 0) AS ai_calls_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT u.stat_date) FILTER (WHERE u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 29) AS active_days_30d, COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count) FILTER (WHERE u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 6), 0) AS requests_last7, COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count) FILTER ( WHERE u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 13 AND u.stat_date < CURRENT_DATE - 6), 0) AS requests_prev7, MAX(u.stat_date) AS last_active_date

SELECT
FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN tenant_quota q ON q.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND q.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN tenant_usage_daily u ON u.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND u.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 29 WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY t.tenant_code, e.company_name, e.industry, t.plan_id, t.status, t.isolation_mode, t.expire_time, t.create_time, q.daily_request_limit, q.ai_daily_limit ORDER BY t.expire_time NULLS LAST, t.create_time
